The trip from Salvador to Morro de São Paulo is easier when you know what each stretch looks like.

A ferry across the bay, a van along the coast, and a fast boat for the last few minutes. We walk you through it step by step, plus a few things worth knowing before you land.

Send us your arrival date and we'll help you choose how to get here.
